name: Fuyou Momiji
source:
Momiji Fuyou is Kaede Fuyou's mother and the wife of Mikio Fuyou. Her only appearance in the visual novels is as a secondary character in Really? Really!.

From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Shuffle!_characters#Momiji_Fuyou]Wikipedia[/url]
